title: Vibrant Tangy Filipino Prosciutto Skewers
description: A tangy and cozy Filipino dish featuring prosciutto, this recipe is Whole30-friendly and perfect for a snack or dinner. The combination of prosciutto and Filipino flavors creates a unique and delicious taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread a slice of prosciutto, a pineapple chunk, a red onion slice, and a sprinkle of cilantro onto each bamboo skewer.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, and coconut milk.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the prosciutto and pineapple.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the prosciutto is crispy.
Garnish with additional cilantro and lime wedges if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
